chinese: 水善利万物而不争，处众人之所恶，故几于道。
居善地，心善渊，与善仁，言善信，
pinyin: Shuǐ shàn lì wàn wù ér bù zhēng， chù zhòng rén zhī suǒ è， gù jǐ yú dào。
Jū shàn dì， xīn shàn yuān， yǔ shàn rén， yán shàn xìn，
Zhèng shàn zhì， shì shàn néng， dòng shàn shí。
Fū wéi bù zhēng， gù wú yóu。
english:
The supreme good is like water,
which benefits all of creation
without trying to compete with it.
It gathers in unpopular places.
Thus it is like the Tao.

The location makes the dwelling good.
Depth of understanding makes the mind good.
A kind heart makes the giving good.
Integrity makes the government good.
Accomplishment makes your labors good.
Proper timing makes a decision good.

Only when there is no competition
will we all live in peace.
